subject: [PATCH 04/10] mm/madvise: use the PMD softleaf validity helper

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch replaces a custom check for non-present huge PMD entries in the madvise code with the pmd_is_valid_softleaf() helper function, which is defined centrally and expresses the invariant that such entries must be software leaf types supported at the PMD level. This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves code consistency by using a standard validation method. The patch also removes redundant checks for specific entry types.
